ev_tuntetes_head: Tens of thousands march the streets — the police are busy with the protesters
ev_tuntetes_body: Officers are escorting the crowd and nobody watches the side streets. Smaller jobs go easier now.
ev_tuntetes_end: The protest is over; patrols are back on the streets.
ev_kommando_head: Special forces have taken over the city — armed units on every corner
ev_kommando_body: Elite units are sweeping the districts. Whoever gets caught now sits for a long time.
ev_kommando_end: The special forces have withdrawn; the pressure eases.
ev_helikopter_head: A police helicopter is circling over the city
ev_helikopter_body: A thermal-camera helicopter watches the streets — getting away is almost impossible now.
ev_helikopter_end: The helicopter has landed; the sky is dark again.
ev_kamerak_head: The city-wide CCTV system has gone dark
ev_kamerak_body: A hacker attack crippled the cameras — nobody sees anything.
ev_kamerak_end: The CCTV system has been restored.
ev_hovihar_head: A blizzard has paralysed the city
ev_hovihar_body: Everyone stays home and the roads are impassable — few targets, but the police are slow too.
ev_hovihar_end: The snow has stopped and the roads are clear.
ev_kanikula_head: Heat alert: 40 degrees in the shade
ev_kanikula_body: People are careless and bags are open — but the heat makes the police short-tempered too.
ev_kanikula_end: The air has cooled; the heat alert is over.
ev_meccs_head: A sold-out derby — the crowd has flooded the area
ev_meccs_body: Sixty thousand fans around the stadium: packed trams and full pockets.
ev_meccs_end: The match is over; the stadium area has emptied.
ev_valasztas_head: Campaign season: politicians are cracking down on crime
ev_valasztas_body: Everyone promises toughness — fines and bail are sky-high and bribes are expensive.
ev_valasztas_end: The campaign is over; the crackdown eases.
ev_birosag_head: The courts' case handling has collapsed
ev_birosag_body: A backlog of thousands: judges sentence everyone quickly and lightly.
ev_birosag_end: The backlog is cleared; the courts are strict again.
ev_inflacio_body: Tills hold more cash — but fines, bail and bribes cost more too.
ev_inflacio_end: Inflation has slowed; prices have calmed down.
ev_recesszio_body: Shops are closing and people carry little cash — loot is much smaller.
ev_recesszio_end: The recession is over; the economy is spinning again.
ev_kartell_head: A foreign cartel has taken over the turf
ev_kartell_body: The new cartel skims the loot and won't tolerate competition.
ev_kartell_end: The cartel has pulled out; the turf belongs to the locals again.
ev_fegyverek_head: An arms shipment has reached the black market
ev_fegyverek_body: Cheap, good gear for everyone — crews get bolder, but the authorities are nervous too.
ev_fegyverek_end: The shipment is gone; gear is expensive again.
ev_besugo_head: An informant is working for the police in the underworld
ev_besugo_body: Someone is leaking everything — crew heists are almost sure to get busted.
ev_besugo_end: The informant has been exposed; the crews trust each other again.
ev_bankpanik_head: Panic: people have withdrawn their money from the banks
ev_bankpanik_body: Banks are locked down, but the cash now sits at home, in safes.
ev_bankpanik_end: Trust is back; the money is in the banks again.
ev_nyaralas_head: Everyone is on holiday — homes and shops stand empty
ev_nyaralas_body: Owners are at the seaside and half the guards are on leave.
ev_nyaralas_end: The holidaymakers are back; the city is busy again.
ev_digitalis_head: Mandatory card payments have been introduced
ev_digitalis_body: There's hardly any cash in pockets, and every transaction is monitored.
ev_digitalis_end: The decree was withdrawn; cash is back.
ev_kriptozuhanas_body: Panic selling: the bitcoin price is in free fall.
ev_kriptoszarnyalas_body: Everyone is buying bitcoin — the price is climbing steeply.
ev_maffiabeke_body: Calm on the streets: the police relax, but the families split the loot strictly.
ev_maffiabeke_end: The truce has broken; tension is back.
ev_orgazda_head: Fences are paying for anything taken from cars
ev_orgazda_body: An Eastern European network buys anything: radios, laptops, parts.
ev_orgazda_end: The fencing network has been busted.
ev_korrupt_nav_head: A corruptible tax auditor sits in the office
ev_korrupt_nav_body: For an envelope every paper checks out — laundering is cheap and safe now.
ev_korrupt_nav_end: The auditor was transferred; the office is strict again.
rob_zseb_desc: Unnoticed, small sum: better odds, little heat, mild penalty
rob_utcai_desc: The classic: medium odds, medium loot
rob_fegyveres_desc: Big loot, but poor odds, lots of heat, a harsh fine and a long jail term
rob_flavor_zsebmetszes: In a crowd you lifted their wallet unnoticed.
rob_flavor_utcai: In a dark alley you lightened their pockets.
rob_flavor_fegyveres: You pulled a gun and they handed over the cash without a word.
